description.en: The Ivory-billed Woodpecker is one of the most legendary and elusive birds in the world. Often referred to as the 'Lord God Bird' due to its impressive size and striking appearance, it was historically the largest woodpecker in North America. Characterized by its massive, ivory-colored bill and distinctive black-and-white plumage, the species became a symbol of the loss of virgin old-growth forests in the Southeastern United States. Despite numerous reported sightings in the 21st century, including the controversial 2004 Arkansas encounter, its continued existence remains a subject of intense debate among ornithologists. It requires vast tracts of mature hardwood swamps with high concentrations of dead and dying trees to support its specialized diet.
description.zh: 象牙喙啄木鸟是世界上最传奇且最神秘的鸟类之一。因其体型巨大、外表惊人，常被称为“上帝之鸟”。它曾是北美洲最大的啄木鸟，以其巨大的象牙色鸟喙和鲜明的黑白羽毛为特征。该物种已成为美国东南部原始老龄林流失的象征。尽管在21世纪有多次目击报告（包括2004年引起巨大争议的阿肯色州目击事件），但其是否依然存世仍是鸟类学界激烈争论的话题。它们生存高度依赖大面积的成熟硬木沼泽林，这些森林必须含有高密度的枯死木，以提供其特化的食物来源。

anatomy.en: Reaching lengths of 48 to 53 cm with a wingspan of up to 80 cm, the Ivory-billed Woodpecker is massive. Its most prominent feature is the large, chisel-shaped, ivory-white bill composed of bone covered in a keratinous sheath. The plumage is predominantly shiny black with prominent white wing patches and two white stripes running from the cheek down the neck to the back. Males possess a conspicuous pointed red crest, while females have a black crest. Unlike the Pileated Woodpecker, the Ivory-billed shows white on the trailing edge of the wing when folded and lacks the white facial striping seen in its smaller relative.
anatomy.zh: 象牙喙啄木鸟体长可达48至53厘米，翼展达80厘米，体型极巨。其最显著的特征是巨大的、凿状的象牙白色鸟喙，由覆盖着角质鞘的骨骼组成。羽毛主要为闪亮的黑色，带有显著的白色翼斑，两条白纹从脸颊沿颈部延伸至背部。雄性拥有显眼的尖形红色羽冠，而雌性的羽冠为黑色。与北美黑啄木鸟不同，象牙喙啄木鸟在翅膀折叠时可见后缘的白色，且缺乏后者脸部的白色条纹。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This species is a highly specialized insectivore, primarily feeding on the large larvae of wood-boring beetles (Cerambycidae, Buprestidae, and Elateridae). They use their powerful bills to strip large sheets of bark from recently dead trees to reach the larvae beneath. Their social structure is believed to involve long-term pair bonds. A defining behavioral trait is the 'double-knock' drum—two rapid, powerful strikes on a hollow tree—which is characteristic of the genus Campephilus. They are strong, direct flyers, often compared to ducks in flight due to their rapid wingbeats and lack of the typical woodpecker undulation.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 该物种是高度特化的食虫动物，主要捕食天牛、吉丁虫和叩甲等木材钻孔昆虫的大型幼虫。它们利用强有力的喙从刚枯死的树木上剥下大片树皮，以获取下方的幼虫。其社会结构被认为涉及长期的配偶关系。一个标志性的行为特征是“双击”敲击声——在空心树干上发出两次快速、有力的撞击，这是象牙喙啄木鸟属的典型特征。它们飞行强劲且笔直，由于振翅频率快且缺乏典型啄木鸟的波浪式起伏，飞行姿态常被比作野鸭。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Historically, the Ivory-billed Woodpecker inhabited the vast bottomland hardwood forests and longleaf pine savannas of the Southeastern United States and Cuba. They required large, contiguous areas of undisturbed forest with an abundance of dead wood, typically found in river basins like the Mississippi Delta and the swamps of Florida. Extensive logging following the Civil War decimated their habitat. The last universally accepted sighting in the US occurred in the Singer Tract of Louisiana in 1944, while a separate subspecies (C. p. bairdii) persisted in the mountain forests of Eastern Cuba until the late 1980s.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 历史上，象牙喙啄木鸟栖息在美国东南部和古巴广阔的底层硬木林和长叶松稀树草原中。它们需要大面积、连贯且未受干扰的原始森林，并含有丰富的枯木，通常分布在密西西比河三角洲和佛罗里达沼泽等流域。南北战争后的大规模伐木摧毁了它们的栖息地。美国最后一次被公认的目击记录于1944年发生在路易斯安那州的辛格林地，而另一个亚种（古巴亚种）在古巴东部的山区森林中一直存在到20世纪80年代末。

habitat.text_en: Deep river-bottom hardwood swamps and old-growth pine forests of the Southeastern US and Cuba.
habitat.text_zh: 美国东南部及古巴深处的河流底层硬木沼泽和老龄松林。
